title: Rewrite README quickstart and execute it in CI
acceptance: scripts/quickstart_check.sh executes every quickstart command in a scratch repo and exits 0 in CI
README contains no duplicate bootstrap step and states .arm/ vs .armature/ correctly once
docs/getting-started.md agrees with README on paths
README installation section covers go install and released binaries
definition_of_done: The quickstart is rewritten against a fresh clone with every command verified verbatim: duplicate skill-install step removed, the .arm/ worktree vs .armature/ state-dir distinction stated once and matching getting-started.md, README installation covers go install and released binaries, and a CI job extracts and runs the quickstart commands in a scratch repo so future drift fails the build.
